channel.title: Ghana - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Ghana, every source cited.

item.title: Ghana Airport Company Limited marks 20 years
item.description: The company pledged to strengthen airport infrastructure and improve passenger experience.

item.title: Zenith Bank Ghana marks 21 years with health walk
item.description: The bank organized a seven-kilometre walk to promote healthy living and strengthen relationships with stakeholders.

item.title: Sakumono murder suspect arrested with pistol in Ashanti Region
item.description: Police retrieved a Smith & Wesson pistol and seven rounds of ammunition from the 72-year-old suspect.

item.title: Fitch Solutions forecasts Ghana's 2026 growth at nearly 6%
item.description: The firm expects Ghana's economy to slow to 4.7% growth in 2027 due to rising inflation.
